html:
Repository layout and local development host

ForgeMCP contains three separately running components:

Directory Purpose
Plugins/Forge Unreal plugin source and descriptor; displayed as ForgeMCP
blender-addon/majestic_forge Blender add-on source; displayed as ForgeMCP
server External authenticated MCP server and shared workflow coordination
scripts Setup, packaging, installation, host creation and native verification
tests Python unit and MCP subprocess regression tests
Documentation Installation, security, capability evidence and original roadmap

The on-disk Unreal plugin directory is Forge. Its descriptor filename, MajesticForge Unreal module IDs and majestic_forge Python package name remain stable for existing project and add-on compatibility. The shared session folder also remains %LOCALAPPDATA%/MajesticForge/sessions.

The working ForgeMCPDev.uproject, root Source, Config, Content, build outputs and application state remain local. They are ignored by Git and are not removed from disk. This preserves ongoing development without publishing local scenes, credentials, personal settings or unrelated Marketplace plugin requirements.

Use scripts/create_unreal_host.py to create a separate minimal development host from the published plugin source. The generator refuses an existing destination. Unreal Engine must be installed separately. Historical commits may contain the earlier minimal development-host scaffold; the current checkout excludes it.

Generated ZIPs, Unreal binaries, Python environments, local API indexes and private session registrations are excluded from source control. Build/install packages locally; no proprietary engine binaries or third-party Marketplace plugins are included in this source repository.
